description: Replication Data for: Climate Resilient Sanitary Sewers Through Minimized Inflow is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Gabrielle Migliato Marega, Jennifer A. P. Drake. Data to support the paper entitled: "Climate Resilient Sanitary Sewers Through Minimized Inflow." To demonstrate the analytical model presented in the associated paper, we applied the proposed model to three capital cities. This dataset contains the assumptions used for each city and the associated outputs. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the Dataverse metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
